module: Manages drift UI sounds (FMOD events UI>Career>Drift_*): a continuous sound during a drift whose pitch follows the performance factor, a sound on each new tier, on each combo change, when the drift is canceled (crash/spinout) and when points are validated. Also contains a "Drift audio" imgui window to simulate a drift in debug. Loaded by gameplay_drift_general as long as the drift display extension is loaded.
notes: Sounds: continuousDrift = event:>UI>Career>Drift_Counting, newTier = Drift_Tier, newCombo1 = Drift_Combo_1x, newCombo5 = Drift_Combo_5x, driftCanceled = Drift_Canceled, pointsConfirmed = Drift_PointsReceived.
The continuous sound is cut when the drift is paused or frozen (gameplay_drift_general.getPaused/getFrozen); otherwise it plays as long as gameplay_drift_drift.getIsDrifting() is true.
The tier sound volume is tierData.order - 1 (so 0 for the tier of order 1).
The combo sound uses comboChange <= 0.2 to choose Combo_1x, otherwise Combo_5x.
The local function reset() is not exported: general.reset therefore cannot call it.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=false, canBeChanged=true} for the drift debug window.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: on the first call creates the audio source of the continuous sound, displays the debug window, then plays/stops the continuous sound and updates its pitch parameter and its position (camera).

_dtSim.desc: Simulated delta time, stored for debug transitions.

onNewDriftTierReached.desc: Hook: plays the new tier sound.

tierData.desc: Tier data; order is used for the volume.

onDriftNewCombo.desc: Hook: plays the 1x or 5x combo sound depending on the size of the change.

onDriftCrash.desc: Hook: plays the drift cancel sound.

onDriftSpinout.desc: Hook: plays the drift cancel sound.

onDriftDebugChanged.desc: Hook: when debug is disabled, stops the drift simulation (gameplay_drift_drift.simulateADrift()).

onDriftCompletedScored.desc: Hook: plays the points received sound.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: removes the audio source of the continuous sound on unload.
